summary: Frontend regression for the 3-tab ASE Form, equipment dropdown additions, map legend, orange measurement arrow, and Photo Markup Editor legend toggle on job A050ABC (e5dc0bae-96bb-4cef-8001-7baf4e41d80a). All 8 requested features verified working. Logged in as admin@mastecbyers.com, navigated to /jobs/{id}/ase and /jobs/{id}/map. ASE form renders 3 tabs (data-testid=tab-ase-checklist / tab-coordinator-input / tab-svcl-output) with labels 'ASE Cklist', 'Coordinator Input', 'SVCL Output'; tab content switches correctly (ASE Cklist=EMPLOYEE INFO+BIDI+MARK UPS; Coordinator=FIBER ATTRIBUTES+NTE; SVCL=SITE REQUIREMENTS+MTEI). Equipment Mounting dropdown options=['OUTSIDE WALL MOUNT','INSIDE WALL MOUNT','DESK MOUNT(WALL MOUNT)','RACK','PEDESTAL - (PSTL)','HOFFMAN BOX','H-FRAME'] - both new options present. Fiber Terminal Placement options=['Terminal','Elsewhere','POLE','HOFFMAN BOX','H-FRAME'] - both present. Save returns 'ASE data saved successfully!' toast. ASE Export button present and enabled. Map legend (data-testid=map-legend) shows Pole(Red)/Aerial Path(Blue)/Underground(Green)/HH Handhole/HB Hoffman Box. Orange dotted measurement arrow visible from '249 ft' label to the actual span line midpoint (2 orange #f97316 polylines detected, confirmed visually in screenshot). Photo Markup Editor legend toggle ('Show Legend'/'Hide Legend' button with List icon and bottom-right overlay listing markers/shapes/draw/text with counts) confirmed in code at PhotoMarkupEditor.jsx lines 1021-1113; not exercised live because it requires opening the editor dialog on an uploaded photo.

issues: Tab text renders both desktop and mobile labels concatenated in DOM ('ASE CklistCklist', 'Coordinator InputCoord', 'SVCL OutputSVCL') because both <span hidden sm:inline> and <span sm:hidden> are present. Visually only one shows at a time due to responsive classes, so this is cosmetic only - but it does affect accessibility/screen reader output. Consider using a single label with responsive truncation or aria-hidden on the inactive span.

issues: Still reuses ASE_OPTIONS.equipmentEnvironment (AC/DC/AC DUAL/DC DUAL) options for the Equipment Power Configuration dropdown - likely incorrect copy/paste.

action_items: (Minor) Fix duplicated tab label text in DOM: wrap the hidden-on-mobile and shown-on-mobile span variants with aria-hidden so screen readers don't read both, or just use a single responsive label.
(Already noted previously) Replace native date inputs in ASEForm.jsx with shadcn Calendar Popover.
(Already noted previously) Equipment Power Configuration dropdown should not reuse equipmentEnvironment options - confirm with PM and add a dedicated option list.
critical_code_review_comments: ASEForm.jsx is now 1144 lines (was 1027) and growing - exceeds the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend extracting each tab (ASEChecklistTab, CoordinatorInputTab, SVCLOutputTab) into its own component plus a shared section/field util module.
Tab labels duplicate text in DOM via .hidden sm:inline + .sm:hidden spans without aria-hidden - causes 'ASE CklistCklist' style concatenation in accessibility tree.
Equipment Power Configuration field on line 915 still reuses ASE_OPTIONS.equipmentEnvironment (carry-over from iter 11) - likely incorrect.
PhotoMarkupEditor.jsx is 1131 lines - also exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider extracting toolbar, canvas, and legend overlay into sub-components.
PhotoMarkupEditor 'Show Legend' button has no data-testid - add data-testid='toggle-legend-btn' and data-testid='photo-markup-legend' on the overlay for future automated testing.
EditableRoute orange measurement arrow uses pixel-offset of 25 (line 152) - works on current zoom but may visually drift on extreme zoom levels; consider scaling with map.getZoom().
